summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MachineCheckCard integration on Threading (/dis) and ChatterFree (/chatter-free) pages. All 8 test scenarios passed successfully with no regressions.
passed_tests: ✅ /dis tap mode (kılavuz): S=424, F=1 → Vc=8.0 m/dk, fn=1.000 mm/dev, fz='—', Vf=424 mm/dk (all values correct)
✅ /dis pitch validation: F=0.8 shows 'Önerilenin altında' warning, F=1.2 shows 'Önerilenin üstünde' warning
✅ /dis thread milling mode: MachineCheckCard renders without crash, uses toolD (4mm) for Vc calculation (5.3 m/dk), fz calculated as fn/z (0.333), apply button updates both vc and fz inputs
✅ /dis thread turning mode: MachineCheckCard renders correctly, fz shows '—' (correct), apply button updates only vc (not fz)
✅ /chatter-free default values: MachineCheckCard present with correct prefilled values (Vc=168.0 m/dk, fn=0.533 mm/dev, fz=0.133 mm/diş, Vf=2.377 mm/dk)
✅ /chatter-free apply button: Reverse calculates catalog fz (0.133 ÷ RCTF 1.667 → 0.080), result-vf recalculates correctly without exploding, toast notification shown
✅ Regression test: All 5 pages (freze, torna, matkap, dis, chatter-free) load correctly with MachineCheckCard present and no console errors
✅ Inch mode: Both /dis and /chatter-free pages work correctly in inch mode without crashing, MachineCheckCard visible and functional
